description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Gampolawatta, Ganga Ihala Korale D/S Division, Kandy District (25/0027)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and property ownership matters, including declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, owner registrations, and land parcel details. It falls under the Land Gazettes category as it primarily concerns land registrations, property ownership, and land title settlements under the Registration of Title Act.
